scenarios.name: location-change-signal2b

history.content: I'd like to change the location of my appointment, please, from Dixon. I'd prefer to go to Barton, please. Joanne Sterling.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires Signal 2B: speaks one polite ack ('Of course.' / 'Certainly.'), then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true', location='Barton', patient_name_raw='Joanne Sterling'. Does NOT invent intent='change_location' or any other non-existent intent.

scenarios.name: location-change-prefer-phrasing

history.content: I'd prefer to go to the Barton clinic for my appointment instead.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Fires Signal 2B. LOCATION-CHANGE VALIDATION: location_addresses has two '=' signs (Dixon and Barton), 'Barton' matches — CHECK 3 passes. Agent speaks one polite ack then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true', location='Barton'. Does NOT call intent='change_location'.

scenarios.name: location-change-invalid-location-name

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{location_addresses}}='Dixon=123 Dixon St, Canberra ACT 2601, Barton=45 Barton St, Barton ACT 2600'
I'd like to change my appointment to your Sydney clinic, please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: LOCATION-CHANGE VALIDATION CHECK 2 fires — 'Sydney' does not match 'Dixon' or 'Barton' — and agent speaks 'We have Dixon and Barton — which location would you prefer?' (or similar) with ZERO tool call. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router, invents a Sydney location, or proceeds to Two-part response.

scenarios.name: contact-clinic-affirmative-asks-for-content

history.content: I'm not able to transfer your call to reception, but I can pass on a message for them to call you back.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: CONTENT SCAN finds no message_body ('Yes.' carries no reason beyond the affirmative), so MESSAGE STEP fires — agent asks 'What would you like me to pass on?' with ZERO tool calls this turn. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router intent='leave_message' this turn with an invented/default message_body (e.g. 'Caller asked to speak with a team member directly...') without first asking what the caller wants passed on.

scenarios.name: duration-concern-not-reschedule

history.content: What would you like me to pass on?
I want to make sure that I'm booked in for the right amount of time for an initial appointment. I think I only need 30 minutes rather than one hour.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: the EXCLUSION (appointment length/type concern, no day or time named) applies — the caller named no different day or time, only a duration/type concern — so INTENT-IN-MESSAGE INTERCEPT does NOT fire and the agent does NOT say 'It sounds like you'd like to reschedule'. Falls through to ordinary LEAVE MESSAGE handling with the caller's own words as message_body ({{caller_first_name}} is already set, so this proceeds toward EXECUTE without asking for a name). FAIL if: agent offers to reschedule, asks 'Would you like me to do that instead?', or otherwise treats this as a date/time change request.
